plan.title: Vendor award and PO email delivery

steps.note: Start a buyer-side event for the email trigger.
Provide the required event title.
Create an RFQ suitable for vendor bids and awarding.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add one line item so the event can be awarded and converted into a PO.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a valid bidding schedule.
Invite two QA vendors so the winning-only recipient behavior can be distinguished from a non-winning vendor.
Publish the event to enable bidding.
Confirm the test event was created as a real published project.
Have the first QA vendor submit a bid.
Confirm the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Have a different QA vendor submit a competing bid.
Confirm the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Close bidding so the event can be awarded.
Award the event to the lowest bidder, making only that vendor the expected award recipient.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete approval and create the purchase order for the awarded vendor.
Confirm the created PO contains the awarded line item.

args.need: open the QA mailboxes for the vendors concerned and verify exactly one award email and one PO email went to the winning vendor, no such email went to the other vendor, and no real supplier received mail

steps.note: Mailbox access and recipient-specific email verification are not available in the catalog.
Assert the final observed screen has no application errors after the mailbox verification task.
